historical_native_reference.scope: earlier three-CPU H0 run; not rerun in this campaign

protocol_proof.scope: Requires both sampled deferred materialization and separate TopK worker pools per treatment node, all on the full node mask; control requires neither pool. Sampling presence is not a utilization or phase-coverage estimate.

ring_admission_proof.counter_semantics: Process-global per-node ring counters increment once per query member submitted/completed; measured-row delta includes 16 warmup requests times batch size plus successful timed queries and final drain.

stage_diagnostics.scope: Per-node metric deltas and their three-node mean; stage work/wait counters can overlap and are not additive critical-path latency.
